description: This file defines a class Base64VLQ used for encoding and decoding VLQ (Variable Length Quantity) values in Base64 for source map generation, based on Google Closure Compiler implementation.

classes.name: Base64VLQ
classes.description: Provides methods to encode integers into Base64 VLQ strings and decode such strings back into integers, used in source map generation.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes an integer value into a Base64 VLQ string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 VLQ string back into an integer.

methods.name: toVLQSigned
methods.description: Converts a signed integer to a VLQ-signed integer using two's complement encoding.

methods.name: fromVLQSigned
methods.description: Converts a VLQ-signed integer back to a signed integer using two's complement decoding.
